text:
I understand your frustration—a week's wait is too long when a plant's life is at stake.

To help you, I need a bit more information:

1. **When was your plant delivered?** (This determines if you're still within the 30-day guarantee window)
2. **Do you have your order number?** (It looks like `LF-` plus six digits)

Once I confirm you're within the guarantee window, you can file a claim from "My Orders" with **two photos** (whole plant + close-up), and a Plant Care Specialist will review it within **2 business days**—no need to send the plant back. If approved, you'll get a free replacement of the same plant.

What's your order number and delivery date?
